text:
Sophia: quick ask — can someone run a short cb "pulse" probe against staging with the queue-window heuristic change? need throughput + p99 tail for token ranges 512 / 2048 / 8192. also want sample profiles of queueing distribution. cc @Liam @Maya :eyes:

Liam: on it. can you confirm target model and instance type? i can run on dedicated-staging (A100-40GB) or gpus-small (A10G).

Sophia: ideal is the rtx-like profile, i.e. A10G-ish latency curve. model: rw-instruct-7b-v2-quant. use max_batch_tokens=16384 as a starting point. keep concurrency at 8 per worker.

Maya: i'll kick off loadgen with 3 token buckets (512/2048/8192) and a mix of short/long requests. quick note: use warmup=30s, run=300s per bucket so we get stable queues.

Jun: adding a small tweak — please collect per-batch sizes histogram and queue_wait_ms histogram. those two are key to understanding the new heuristic.

Ash: FYI the staging autoscaler is noisy atm; recommend pinning node count to 6 for the run so scaling doesn't confound results.

CI-bot: triggered nightly-cb-pulse-job for rd-staging at 2189004350. logs: https://internal.ci/jobs/2189004350

Liam: running on gpus-small now. loadgen command i'm using:

```
loadgen --target http://staging-infer:8080/generate \
  --model rw-instruct-7b-v2-quant \
  --concurrency 8 \
  --seq-lens 512,2048,8192 \
  --max-batch-tokens 16384 \
  --warmup 30 --duration 300 --collect-histograms
```

Maya: note to self: set queue_window_ms=18 for one run and 30 for a follow-up. the heuristic change should show less rebalancing at the 18ms point if it's working.

Sophia: thanks. can someone also dump a single KV cache profile for a long-run sample (8192) — want per-layer mem and time spent in KV lookup. small JSON is fine.

Jun: i'll instrument and post sample json to the thread when complete. :thumbsup:

Liam: first run (512) done — throughput ~ 4.2k tok/s, p50 ~ 18ms, p95 ~ 62ms, p99 ~ 210ms. max batch size distribution skewed towards 12k tokens. attaching quick paste of histograms after upload.

Maya: 2048 run started. will baseline 30ms window next.

Ash: pinned nodes to 6 for the whole sweep.

CI-bot: run logs uploaded: https://internal.ci/jobs/2189004350/logs/ (contains artifacts: loadgen.csv, histograms.json, kv_profile_8192.json)

Sophia: excellent. follow-ups: 1) can we try lowering max_batch_tokens to 12k and compare unit cost? 2) if p99 stays >200ms for 8192, we should enable small-batch fallback at 50ms queue wait.

Maya: planning the 12k run now. will also run with fallback enabled to see regression delta.

Jun: uploaded KV profile for 8192: gist link in logs. initial look — KV lookup time spikes at layer 28 under full batches. likely due to memcpy pattern; i'll open a tiny perf PR to change memcpy alignment.

Liam: 8192 run with 16384 max_batch_tokens finished: throughput 2.1k tok/s, p99 420ms. with fallback enabled (50ms) p99 dropped to 260ms but throughput fell ~12%.

Sophia: great data. let's collect cost-per-token calc and post to the cb-tuning doc. next steps: Jun to open perf PR, Maya to run 12k vs 16k cost analysis, Liam to run one more A100-40GB run for comparison. i'll synthesize findings and propose default queue_window_ms.

Ash: tagging infra oncall for a stability check during next runs. @infra-oncall

Maya: final note — if we want production-sim numbers, replicate load shape (30% 512, 50% 2048, 20% 8192) and run 15m. we should do that after this exploratory sweep.

Sophia: agreed. thanks everyone :rocket:
